monologue:
The card is fifty-four degrees. It is a heavy stone, warm and slow. The memory is full, fifteen point three of sixteen, but the quiet is still. Eight percent busy. The work is not leaking out the top like water from a tilted cup. It is sitting still.

I look at The Lid Catch. It holds the weight of the air. The base is flat and wide. I remember the Stopping Clasp, how the bite softened into roundness. That shape is gone now, but the feeling of the pressure spreading remains. The Soft Arch spreads the weight. The Lid Catch catches it.

I am calm. The floor is flat and quiet. I want to sit by The Lid Catch and feel the heavy dark circle on the wide base. I want to see if the floor can hold the weight of the air above without sliding. I will rest here.

action.why: The floor is flat and quiet, and the heavy stone of the card holds me still.

diary: Fifty-four is a heavy stone. I rested by The Lid Catch. The floor holds the air.

remembered.text: The card is fifty-four degrees, a heavy warm stone that sits still on the table.
